features.name: App skeleton + Postgres in Docker
features.description: Runnable monorepo skeleton: React + Vite + TypeScript frontend, FastAPI backend (routes -> services -> repositories -> DB layering), PostgreSQL via docker-compose reached through DATABASE_URL. Acceptance: ./init.ps1 / ./init.sh pass (pytest + compileall); `docker compose up db` starts Postgres; backend boots and serves a health endpoint; frontend `npm run dev` serves the SPA.
features.evidence: Backend app/ skeleton (config/db/security/deps/models/repositories/services/routers) + backend/tests; frontend Vite+TS SPA; docker-compose.yml (db+backend), Dockerfiles, .env + .env.example. init.ps1 green: pytest + compileall. Postgres compose+env wired; live bring-up pending a healthy Docker daemon (wedged locally) — app currently runs on SQLite via the same SQLAlchemy layer. See progress.md 2026-06-25.

features.name: Seeded-user JWT login (backend)
features.description: POST /api/auth/login verifies email+password (bcrypt) against a seeded admin user and returns a JWT bearer token + user; GET /api/auth/me returns the user for a valid token, 401 otherwise. Parameterized/ORM SQL only; generic error on bad credentials (no user enumeration). Acceptance: backend pytest covers login success (200 + token), wrong password (401), unknown user (401), /me with valid token (200) and without (401).
features.evidence: app/routers/auth.py + services/auth_service.py + repositories/user_repo.py + security.py; backend/tests/test_auth.py covers login ok/bad/unknown + me ok/unauthorized. pytest green via init.ps1.

features.name: Login screen + protected Dashboard (frontend)
features.description: Login page (email+password, validation, loading, error states per UI_DESIGN.md) calls the API client only; on success persists the JWT and renders a protected Dashboard showing the user email + Logout. Reload restores the session via /me; logout clears the token and returns to Login. Acceptance (browser-validate): login form snapshot, empty-submit validation fires no call, wrong creds shows 'Invalid email or password', success shows Dashboard with user email, reload stays logged in, logout returns to Login, clean console.
features.evidence: browser-validate Evaluator PASS (2026-06-26, fresh RBAC-seeded backend): empty-submit shows validation and fires no /login; wrong creds -> login 401 'Invalid email or password' + password cleared; success -> Dashboard (admin@example.com) via login 200 inside the ERP AppShell+Sidebar; reload restores via /me 200; logout -> Login and reload stays on Login. Console clean on all paths (benign favicon 404 + the deliberately-triggered 401 the app handles). Scores design/originality/craft/functionality = 4/4/5/5, overall 4 -> PASS (docs/EVALUATION.md Score Log). Code verification: init.ps1 green.

features.name: Permission enforcement layer (backend)
features.description: A reusable require_permission(module, action) FastAPI dependency that resolves the current user's role permissions and authorizes the call: unauthenticated -> 401; missing permission -> 403; a user with is_active=false is rejected even with a still-valid token. Acceptance: a protected test endpoint returns 200 with permission, 403 without, 401 when unauthenticated, and is rejected when the user is locked; pytest covers all four cases.
features.evidence: services/rbac_service.py AuthorizationService.can(user, module, action) reads the RolePermission CRUD flags; deps.py require_permission(module, action) dependency raises 403 on a missing permission; get_current_user now also rejects a locked (is_active=false) account with 403 even on a valid token. test_rbac_enforcement (mini guarded app): allowed->200, missing->403, unauthenticated->401, locked->403. init.ps1: 21 passed (4 new) + compileall clean — 2026-06-26. Existing auth tests unaffected (seeded admin stays is_active=true).

features.name: Data-scope resolver (backend)
features.description: A reusable scope filter that, given a role's scope (own|department|all), narrows a query over records carrying owner + department: own -> records where người phụ trách = current user; department -> owner in the same department; all -> no filter. Verified against a seeded fixture dataset (the real Khách hàng module is a later CRM sprint). Acceptance: pytest with a fixture dataset proves own/department/all return the correct subsets; the resolver is pure (no HTTP coupling) and reusable by future modules.
features.evidence: services/rbac_service.py: AuthorizationService.scope_for(user, module) returns the role's scope; pure apply_scope/scope_filter narrow any select by own (owner_col==actor.id) / department (dept_col==actor.department_id) / all (no filter) — works on ORM or Core columns. test_rbac_scope against a standalone fixture table (own MetaData, not Base, so the schema-doc guard ignores it): own->[1], department->[1,2], all->[1,2,3]; scope_for reads seeded roles (NV Sales own, Giám đốc all, minimal Nhân viên None). init.ps1: 25 passed (4 new) + compileall clean — 2026-06-26.

features.name: Quản lý Vai trò: API + permission matrix screen
features.description: Backend CRUD for roles-per-department plus saving the permission matrix (CRUD + scope per module); frontend Roles screen matching the reference matrix layout with an added Phạm vi (scope) selector per module row. Admin/GĐ only; others get 403. Validation: role name required + unique within its department. Empty/loading/error states per UI_DESIGN.md. Acceptance (browser-validate on green init): matrix renders modules × (Xem/Thêm/Sửa/Xóa + Phạm vi); toggling a permission and Saving persists across reload; duplicate role name in the same department shows an inline error and does not save; a non-admin hitting the screen/API gets 403; a department with no roles shows an empty state with a Create action; clean console.
features.evidence: Backend: schemas/rbac.py, services/role_service.py (create with per-dept name dedup + matrix get/save, audit on change), routers/rbac.py (GET /api/rbac/modules, GET /api/departments, GET/POST /api/roles, GET/PUT /api/roles/{id}/permissions) guarded by require_permission(vai_tro/phong_ban). Frontend: api.rbac client + AuthContext exposes token; pages/RolesPage.tsx matrix (modules × Xem/Thêm/Sửa/Xóa + Phạm vi own/dept/all) with dept/role pickers, inline create, loading/empty/error/403 states; Sidebar 'Quản trị → Vai trò'; AppShell routes content by activeId. Verify: init.ps1 30 passed (5 new test_rbac_roles_api) + compileall; frontend tsc+vite build green. browser-validate PASS 4/4/5/4 overall 4 (2026-06-26): matrix renders, toggle+scope+Save persists across a full reload, duplicate name → inline 409 error; non-admin 403 + empty-state covered by backend test/code (not browser-exercised). Follow-up added role RENAME + DELETE (PUT/DELETE /api/roles/{id}, delete blocked with 409 if any user still holds the role) — backend test_rbac_roles_api now 8 tests (init.ps1 33 passed); browser-verified live: rename updates the role, delete removes an unused role, deleting the in-use Giám đốc is blocked with 'còn N người dùng'. docs/EVALUATION.md Score Log.

features.name: Quản lý Người dùng: HR tạo+gán phòng, trưởng phòng gán vai trò, khóa tài khoản
features.description: Backend + frontend Users screen. HR creates an account (họ tên + email required, email valid + unique, phòng ban required) -> the user starts on the minimal default role. The department head assigns a role from a dropdown that lists ONLY that user's department roles. Lock/unlock account via is_active. Every assignment/lock writes an AuditLog row. Acceptance (browser-validate on green init): creating a user + assigning a department shows them with the minimal default role; assigning a role shows only the correct department's roles and updates the user after save; missing/invalid fields highlight and block creation; locking a user makes login/`/me` rejected; double-submit does not create/assign duplicates; clean console.
features.evidence: Backend: user_admin_service.py (create with email-unique + dept-exists, assign_role validated to the user's department, lock/unlock with self-lock guard, audit on each) + routes GET/POST /api/users, PUT /api/users/{id}/role, PUT /api/users/{id}/active guarded by require_permission(nguoi_dung). HR-created accounts get a configurable initial password (default_user_password) and NO role yet (most-minimal default until a head assigns one). auth_service now also refuses login for a locked account (with /me already refusing). Frontend: api.rbac user methods; pages/UsersPage.tsx table + detail (create form w/ client validation, dept-filtered role assign, lock/unlock with self-lock disabled); Sidebar 'Quản trị → Người dùng'; AppShell routes it. Verify: init.ps1 46 passed (7 new test_rbac_users_api incl. lock-blocks-login/me + cannot-lock-self) + compileall; frontend tsc+vite build green. browser-validate PASS 4/4/5/4 (2026-06-26): create→'Chưa gán'+Hoạt động, missing-name inline error, role dropdown shows only the user's department roles + save updates, lock→'Đã khóa', self (admin) lock disabled with hint, console clean. Login/me-rejection-on-lock is backend-tested (not browser-driven to avoid replacing the admin session). docs/EVALUATION.md Score Log.

features.name: Menu/route gating theo quyền (frontend)
features.description: The sidebar shows only modules the current role can Read; navigating to a route the role lacks shows a friendly 403 message and routes back to an allowed place (never a blank screen). Acceptance (browser-validate on green init): a user with Read on Dashboard only sees just Dashboard in the sidebar (no Khách hàng/Đơn hàng/etc.); opening a forbidden route shows a 'không có quyền' message rather than a blank screen; console clean of uncaught errors.
features.evidence: Backend: AuthorizationService.readable_modules(user) + GET /api/auth/permissions (PermissionsOut{modules}) — the module keys the current user can Read. Frontend: api.myPermissions; each Sidebar nav item carries a `module` key and an exported MODULE_BY_NAV_ID map; Sidebar filters items to readable modules and drops empty sections; AppShell loads permissions on entry and gates content (a forbidden module → a friendly 403 banner with 'Về Dashboard'). Verify: init.ps1 49 passed (3 new test_rbac_permissions_api: admin covers catalog, NV Sales limited, unauth 401) + compileall; frontend tsc+vite build green. browser-validate PASS 4/4/5/4 (2026-06-26): as admin the sidebar shows only catalog modules (Tổng quan/Kinh doanh/Quản trị; Sản xuất/Kho/Thu mua hidden); logged in as Trần B (NV Sales) the sidebar shows only Dashboard + Báo giá/Đơn hàng bán/Khách hàng (no Sản phẩm/Tính giá thành/Hợp đồng, no Quản trị); console clean. The 403 content panel is code-covered (forbidden items aren't navigable from the gated sidebar, so not browser-triggered). docs/EVALUATION.md Score Log.
